title: From contract interface to agent action.
text: A verified interface becomes an MCP tool. The owner sets policy. Orloj validates, simulates and confirms.
note: Edited walkthrough from actual captured screens. The working app runs locally.

title: Register the interface.
text: Start with a Soroban address, XLM or an issued asset. Registration inspects the interface; it never deploys a contract or grants writes.
note: Read-only capture of the existing registration screen.

title: Permission is explicit.
text: Enable balance reads and selected writes. Unsupported or asset-specific operations remain visibly excluded. Unattended spending grants are currently disabled.
note: An enabled method is not an unattended signing grant.

title: Read, without submitting.
text: The same Testnet balance was read through Soroban and the classic DEX adapter. Both results matched independently checked ledger data.
note: Recorded balance snapshot, not a current balance feed.

title: One stroop. Confirmed.
text: A real chat request sent 0.0000001 Testnet XLM. Orloj retained the hash and confirmed success before reporting completion.
note: Historical confirmed transfer. No transaction is sent by this showcase.

title: Recover the result. Never repeat the payment.
text: A provider interruption did not erase the operation. Read-only status recovery returned the original confirmed hash and an exact fee string.
note: Earlier provider and arithmetic failures were documented and corrected.

title: Evidence over promises.
text: 39 confirmed Testnet transactions, including funding and setup. 168 checks passed. Eleven ranked entries audited; five have Testnet write coverage.
note: Provider quotas, unsupported signatures and privileged roles still apply. No hosted backend or mainnet writes.
